App.Title: TrayHider
App.Status.SelfIconShown: TrayHider icon is shown in the notification area
App.Status.Activated: Main window restored by a second launch
App.Status.HotkeyFailed: Failed to register hotkeys (taken by the system or another app): {0}. You can change them in Settings.
App.Error.HotkeyNotReady: The hotkey window is not ready yet.
App.Hotkey.UnavailableDefaults: These default combinations are occupied and saved but will not trigger: {0}. Reassign them individually.
App.RunOnce.ScheduleFail: Failed to create the scheduled task: {0}
App.RunOnce.NotExe: Not running as an .exe, so a scheduled task cannot be created.
App.RunOnce.ScheduleCreated: Scheduled task "{0}" created: re-applies the hidden state every {1} minute(s).
App.RunOnce.Disabled: Non-resident mode disabled; TrayHider is resident again.
App.RunOnce.Caveat:
· At logon the hidden state is applied once and the process exits; a scheduled task re-applies it, so apps started in between show their icon for up to one interval.
· Hidden windows need a resident process, so windows are not hidden in this mode.
